coordinates.units: U=180; +x right, +y down, +z toward camera. Angle degrees clockwise in XY. Motion source channels marked abs/relative and rise retain original y-up signs.
coordinates.planeRoll: Before global actor rotation, a flat door uses X=x+kx*z and Y=y+ky*z after R_x. Local Y column is (kx*sin(rx), cos(rx)+ky*sin(rx)). Use backAsset when determinant is negative; draw edge thickness from lip/hinge, not alpha.
coordinates.opticalRail: Root stays attached at thorax.upper end; its absolute track holds +X for emergence and turns toward +68deg (y-up) after clearance. Two rigid 18-unit sections extend 0..12 each. Head chassis turns on the terminal pivot.

motion.evaluate: For each segment q=(t-start)/(end-start). Invert cubic Bezier x(u) for q, then v=from+(to-from)*y(u). Hold value in gaps. Evaluate all tracks in seconds, no global ease. Angles unwrapped. Pose tracks are absolute in body plane unless explicitly relative.

idle.seedAlgorithm: FNV1a32 UTF-8 of seed + ':' + form + ':' + seedKey, then xorshift32 (13,17,5). Unit sample = unsigned/2^32. Independent draws for phase and dwell.
idle.eventFormula: Dwell times and targets are drawn independently within interval, move with given cubic curve, hold at each end. Head delayed gaze follows same target at own lag/profile. User aim is primary, add micro offsets after clamp. Follower uses the same event targets, own curve and 1.4× movement duration after stated lag.
idle.blend: From currently evaluated pose; apply idle offsets without reseeding at command boundaries. Attenuate capsule deltas over first .24s before gate motion, re-enable mantis offsets continuously after K5 with .42s asymmetric ease. Maintain floor contacts and clearance bands.

channelRules.zRotation: Negate absolute/relative Concept angles for screen-down; local absolute follower = requested world angle minus parent world angle.
channelRules.roll: open degrees times node.rollSignScreen. Positive front-hatch roll carries the leaf outside its front seat. Lower rail gates are 0 in P and fully open by K0.
channelRules.iris: Per-leaf absolute in barrel frame = atan2(pivotY,pivotX) + 180 + 84*clamp(open,0,1); pupil separate from glass and glint.
channelRules.gimbal: Lens yaw in XY = -0.38*aim degrees. Pupil.x = clamp(aim*0.17,-2.4,2.4); use user gaze plus sampled micro offsets.
channelRules.drives: Resolve pins A and B, rotate sleeve to A→B, put distal section at B. Split excess distance over housing between nested stages in proportion to their available strokes. Preserve insertion and test distance bounds for new Stage D trajectories.
channelRules.support: Apply root and foot rolls, then solve 68/76 IK. Retain projected contact on physically selected heel/toe. Never ease the solved leg angles independently away from the anchor.

adjustments.basis: Place axis on upper edge of real elongated cutout; leaf moves completely out of pocket instead of turning its upper part inward.

The solid catch is seated behind the brow of the pocket at x=44. The cheek, its lining and the optical hatch meet at x=50, freeing the original 18-unit amber aperture under the corrected projection.
Recess behind the near limb. Render moving arm ahead of its own opaque liner when the door opens.

Use exact Concept screen projection x+.30*z, y-.10*z and blade face planes at +/-46. Reverse the far slab allocation inside its original bay so the far blade, cap and near counterparts have matching outer planes and 2 units between solids. Preserve IDs, link lengths and the 12-unit sole.
A 24..63 by -33..3 open seat remains around rising lower thorax as the front roof settles. Keep the near-side metal bridge attached; both faces of the part have the throat cutout.
Fixed shell rims, continuous inner faces, one regulator, knee/ankle caps, pupil and glint bind to existing geometry with static IDs.
